disappearance-0.title: Sodder children disappearance
disappearance-0.summary: Five children were believed killed in a house fire, but no remains were found in the ashes.
disappearance-0.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

disappearance-1.title: Roanoke Colony ("Lost Colony")
disappearance-1.summary: About 115 English colonists were gone when the supply ship returned in 1590; only the word "CROATOAN" was carved on a post.
disappearance-1.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

rumors.text: The colonists assimilated with Croatan (Hatteras) or other Native communities.

disappearance-2.title: Flight 19
disappearance-2.summary: Five US Navy Avenger torpedo bombers vanished during a training flight; a PBM Mariner sent to search was also lost.
disappearance-2.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Partly explained / leading theory accepted by many researchers: Navy: likely navigation error and ditching

images.credit: Lt. Comdr. Horace Bristol, U.S. Navy photo 80-G-427475

rumors.text: The Bermuda Triangle swallowed the flight.

disappearance-3.title: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370
disappearance-3.place: Last contact over South China Sea (departed Kuala Lumpur)
disappearance-3.summary: A Boeing 777 with 239 people diverted from its route and vanished; satellite data indicate it ended in the southern Indian Ocean. Debris has washed ashore but the main wreck is not found.
disappearance-3.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

images.credit: The original uploader was Ohconfucius at English Wikipedia.

disappearance-4.title: Amelia Earhart & Fred Noonan
disappearance-4.summary: Earhart and navigator Noonan disappeared trying to reach Howland Island during a round-the-world flight.
disappearance-4.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

rumors.text: They landed on Gardner Island (Nikumaroro) and died as castaways.
She was captured by Japanese forces.

disappearance-5.title: D. B. Cooper hijacking
disappearance-5.summary: An unidentified man hijacked a Boeing 727, collected $200,000 ransom and parachuted into the night; the FBI suspended its case in 2016.
evidence: $5,800 of ransom bills found at Tena Bar (1980).
disappearance-5.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

disappearance-6.title: Flannan Isles lighthouse keepers
disappearance-6.summary: Three keepers vanished; the official inquiry concluded they were swept away by a storm wave.
disappearance-6.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Probable conventional explanation noted by investigators: Inquiry: swept away by wave

disappearance-7.title: Mary Celeste
disappearance-7.place: Atlantic Ocean, east of the Azores
disappearance-7.summary: A brigantine was found adrift, seaworthy, with no one aboard; the crew of 10 was never found.
disappearance-7.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

images.credit: Unconfirmed, possibly Honore Pellegrin (1800–c.1870). This speculative attribution is suggested in Paul Begg: Mary Celes

rumors.text: Alcohol fumes from the cargo prompted the crew to abandon ship.
